description: CHARACTERIZATION FIXTURE for saga #811 (issue #816): this locks TODAY'S DEFECTIVE behaviour, not the correct behaviour. It must be FLIPPED to the correct expectation when the #814 `[spec]` ruling lands and #815 implements it; the wall exists now so the fix is provably a change. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. `check()` half of the pair for the user-procedure form: `p` is well defined and correctly arity-2, and only its SECOND argument is unresolvable. The diagnostic points at `wibble`, not at `p` — the callee is fine.
